$comment: Ledger of npm trusted-publisher claims that npm has confirmed, one entry per
publishable package. Written by scripts/configure-trusted-publishers.mjs (--apply and
--verify) and asserted by scripts/check-trusted-publishers.mjs, which fails a release
when a publishable package has no entry. Do not hand-edit: an invented entry passes the
check and still fails the publish with ENEEDAUTH. See docs/setup/publishing.md.
